Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 149 units of amikacin sulfate 250mg/ml 4ml SDV. Current daily use is 4.3 units, providing 34.4 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage database does not list amikacin sulfate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term. No shortage exists per FDA records. Multiple manufacturers have product available for purchase, though their labels do not identify manufacturing plants.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard purchasing from current suppliers; buyer approves.
2. Qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as an alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
3. Qualify Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. as an alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
4. Qualify Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as an alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
5. Qualify Qilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. as an alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
6. Qualify Sagent Pharmaceuticals as an alternate source; buyer and P&T committee approve.
7. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly; buyer reports changes to P&T committee.

Not recommended: No allocation, conservation, or therapeutic substitution protocols at this time.
